answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 59049 Country: Bangladesh Title: Did Allah create Muhammad (peace be upon him) first? Question: Did Allah create Muhammad (peace be upon him) first? Answer ID: 59049 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 749/738/H=07/1436) The soul of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, was created first in the world of pure spirits, but in this world he was the last of all Prophets to be born. It is proved from the Holy Quran and Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
